ins 476.healthEffect: Used to replace expensive cocoa butter. Safe in small amounts, but overconsumption can cause mild gastrointestinal issues.

ins 442.healthEffect: Improves flow of chocolate during manufacturing. Considered safe within limits, but indicates a highly processed product.

ins 102.healthEffect: Known to cause allergic reactions and hyperactivity in sensitive children.
ins 102.fssaiLimit: Max 100mg/kg. Must carry a warning label.
ins 102.source: FSSAI Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations

ins 621.healthEffect: Can cause headaches or numbness in sensitive individuals. Unsafe for infants.
ins 621.fssaiLimit: Not permitted in pastas and noodles meant for infants. Must declare 'Contains MSG'.

high fructose corn syrup.healthEffect: Spikes blood sugar rapidly. Linked to insulin resistance, obesity, and fatty liver disease.
high fructose corn syrup.fssaiLimit: Must be declared on nutritional label under Total Sugars.

hydrogenated vegetable oil.healthEffect: Significantly increases bad cholesterol (LDL) and lowers good cholesterol (HDL). Major risk for heart disease.
hydrogenated vegetable oil.fssaiLimit: FSSAI limits trans fats to not more than 2% by weight in fats/oils.
